Interface RemoteClientHandler

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClient
public interface RemoteClientHandler extends Remote
Remote interface for RMI client callbacks. Defines methods the server invokes remotely to notify or interact with the client, and methods the client uses to communicate events to the server.
